newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kaneka, Nippon Paper to set up polystyrene venture.
newsitem.headline: Kaneka, Nippon Paper to set up polystyrene venture.

text.p: Kaneka Corp said on Wednesday that it and Nippon Paper Industries Co Ltd will set up a joint venture before the end of this year to produce and market polystyrene paper.
The joint venture, Sun Polymer Corp, will be capitalised at 900 million yen and be 66.7 percent owned by Kaneka and the rest by Nippon Paper, a Kaneka spokesman said.
The new firm expects sales of about 10 billion yen annually, Kaneka said in a statement.
Polystyrene paper is mainly used to make plastic trays for food.
